page.historyTooltip: Published versions and snapshots: compare, restore
page.settingsTooltip: Title, access, sharing, folder, theme and addresses of the deck
page.settingsTooltipSharing: Who can open the presentation, and its individual grants
page.notFoundMessage: The link may be out of date, or the presentation was renamed. If it was shared with another account, sign in with that one.
page.readOnlyMessage: You can open this presentation. To change it, ask a person who edits it for an “Edit” access.
page.signInMessage: Sign in to edit this presentation.
page.failedMessage: The presentation could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.

collab.hint: Draft shared in real time: every change is saved automatically and visible to the other editors.
collab.soloTooltip: Solo mode: you save the draft yourself, and the save is refused when a more recent version exists.

save.conflict: Someone saved this draft in the meantime: reload the page to start again from their version (your changes would have to be applied again).

publication.publishedDescriptionPassword: People with the link and the password see this version.
publication.publishedDescriptionPrivate: The deck is private: Editor and Owner accounts and individual accesses see this version.
publication.hintNeverPublished: Publish the draft to show it to visitors.
publication.hintUnpublished: Visitors see the published version. Publish to update it.
publication.hintUnpublishedSince: Visitors see the version published on {date}. Publish to update it.
publication.hintUpToDateSince: Visitors have seen this draft since {date}.

preview.draftPreview: Preview of the draft, as it will be published
preview.placeholder: Write a title after a # to see the first slide.
preview.fragmentSteps: Show the items one by one
preview.fragmentStepsActive: Items one by one: the preview shows the items up to the one under the cursor
preview.followCursor: Follow the slide under the cursor
preview.followCursorActive: Following the slide under the cursor: on
preview.frame: Preview slide: the arrow keys change the slide

toolbar.heading: Heading {level}
toolbar.formatJson: Indent the JSON block under the cursor, or every JSON block

imageUpload.type: The studio accepts images in the formats {formats}.
imageUpload.size: The image weighs {size} MB, over the {limit} MB limit.
imageUpload.content: The content of the file does not match its extension or is not a readable image.

json.invalidLeft: Invalid JSON block left as is | {n} invalid JSON blocks left as is
json.tourFormatted: JSON block of a JsonTour formatted | {n} JSON blocks of JsonTour formatted
json.tourZonesMoved: The lines named by the ::Zone may have moved.

frontmatter.invalidYaml: Unreadable header line: write one key per line, as key: value.
frontmatter.quoteValue: Put a value that holds “:” between quotes: {line}
frontmatter.quoteValueShort: Line {line}: value to put between quotes
frontmatter.unclosed: Open header: add a --- line above this heading to close it.
frontmatter.unknownKey: Unknown key: check the spelling of “{key}” with Ctrl + Space.
frontmatter.invalidValue: Value refused: pick a value with Ctrl + Space.

expected.number: Value refused: this key takes a number, such as 1280.
expected.boolean: Value refused: this key takes true or false.
expected.string: Value refused: this key takes a text.

frontmatter.unknownTheme: Unknown theme: pick a theme among {themes}.

diagnostics.unknownComponent: Unknown component: check the name “{name}” in the help. The preview shows its content without formatting.
diagnostics.parseFailed: The preview shows the last readable version: undo your last change and redo it in small steps.
diagnostics.refusedUrl: Address refused: write an address that starts with https://, or a path of this site that starts with /.
diagnostics.refusedBinding: Attribute refused: after “:”, write true, false, a number or a text between quotes, and remove v-bind, v-on, {'@'} and v-model.
diagnostics.refusedEmbed: http:// address: the browser blocks this frame, image or video in the studio. Write the address with https://, or with http://localhost for a server on your computer.
diagnostics.overflow: The content reaches below slide {slide}, and the presentation and the PDF cut it: shorten it, split it in two with ---, or give the media a smaller share.
diagnostics.overflowShort: Slide {slide}: content cut at the bottom
diagnostics.imageMissing: Image not found at {src}: check the address, or paste the image into the text to upload it to the studio.

malformedAttributes.brace: Add the {'}'} brace that closes the attributes of “{name}”.
malformedAttributes.quote: Add the " quote that closes a value of “{name}”.
malformedAttributes.typographic: Replace the « » or “ ” quotes in the attributes of “{name}” with straight quotes ".

diagnostics.unclosedBlock: Block {colons}{name} open to the end of the text: add a {colons} line after its content. Without it, the slides that follow go into this block.
diagnostics.layoutUnknownAttribute: Unknown :layout setting: “{name}”. Pick a setting from the help.
diagnostics.layoutInvalidValue: Unknown value for “{name}”. Pick a value from the help.
diagnostics.layoutLegacy: :layout format to convert: click “Convert” in the Layout panel.
diagnostics.layoutMissingSource: Media without an address: add the src or story attribute.
diagnostics.layoutUnused: Remove “{name}”: this setting has no effect with this placement of the media.
diagnostics.layoutBehindNeedsImage: Behind the text, the media is an image: enter its address in src.
diagnostics.layoutBehindNeedsImageShort: Line {line}: image required behind the text

layout.src: Address of the image or the page
layout.heading: Heading
layout.missingSource: Enter the address of an image or a page, or the id of a story.
layout.outside: Place the cursor in a slide to set its layout.
